_comment: Add a _ before an option name to comment it out and it wont be added to the apworld
Using 'goal' as the name of an option let you override some of the generated goal parameters
goal.description: How to End your Randomized playthrough.

filler_traps._comment: Using values here let you set a 'recommended' filler_trap percentage or even a default percentage

shuffle_minigames.description: Adds each minigame level as an unlockable item and location.

shuffle_hats.description: Include the game's 32 hats as locations.

shuffle_cookies.description: Include the game's 200 cookie boxes as locations (warning - adds a lot of filler to the pool).

shuffle_chips.description: Include the game's 200 chip cans as locations (warning - adds a lot of filler to the pool).

shuffle_dvds.description: Include the game's 97 DVDs as locations (warning - adds a lot of filler to the pool).
